The Banker is a senior level position responsible for assisting clients in raising funds in the capital markets, as well as in providing strategic advisory services for mergers, acquisitions and other types of financial transactions in coordination with the Institutional Banking team. The Banker also serves as an intermediary in trading for clients. The overall objective of this role is to act as strategic advisor to our clients by formulating investment strategies and raising capital for clients.
Responsibilities
Leverage past investment banking or related experience to enhance Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) execution and capital raising capabilities and contribute to building Citi's franchise
Meet revenue and other financial goals by establishing and maintaining a pipeline of episodic deals
Ensure that proposed client solutions meet or exceed internal risk and return standards, including stringent ethical standards,
Anticipate future changes in the marketplace
Identify and anticipate all types of risks (e.g. industry, portfolio, diversification, sovereign, commercial, currency, etc.)
Serve as a mentor to junior Bankers, execute staffing models that support business needs and career trajectories for junior staff
Build client relationships by providing sophisticated financial solutions tailored to the clients’ needs and acting as a content provider on market trends
Serve as the expert on regulatory, financial and complex strategic issues relating to corporate finance transactions
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
Recommended Qualifications
15+ years of relevant experience
Experience in people management
Bachelor’s degree in Finance or closely related areas of Business Administration preferred
Master's degree in Business Administration preferred
Experience working in an investment banking institution(s)
Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication
Demonstrated ability to remain unbiased in a diverse working environment
Series 79 and 63 licenses
Education
Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
Master’s degree preferred
Engage in the buildout of China equity capital markets team and design internal deal process, policy and procedures
Lead origination and execution of global ECM transactions with a strong focus on China A-share transactions Lead and manage end-to-end execution of ECM transactions including A-share IPOs, follow-on offerings, rights issues, convertible bonds, and equity-linked products on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE), Shenzhen Stock Exchange (SZSE), and STAR Market (科创板)
Drive origination of new ECM mandates through proactive client engagement, sector expertise, and market intelligence
Coordinate cross-border equity transactions including H-share listings, A+H dual listings, and HKEX IPOs for China-based issuers
Oversee preparation of prospectuses, offering memoranda, regulatory filings, and investor marketing materials to the highest standard of accuracy and compliance
10+ years of relevant ECM origination and execution experience with a deep understanding of China A-share market as well as good knowledge of global capital markets
Solid understanding of local financial markets and ECM product knowledge
Preferably also equipped with DCM product knowledge
Familiarity with CSRC/Exchanges/SAC rules
Experience of covering local institutional investors
Secure and maintain all necessary CSRC licenses (or any other licenses / qualifications as required) for carrying out securities and other regulated activities
Fluent in Mandarin and English
Preference for HK SFC Type 6 licenses / qualifications

jobs.title: Treasury Risk officer - VP, Risk
jobs.descriptionText:
Citibank China Company Ltd. (‘CCCL’) is Citibank’s locally incorporated subsidiary with full-fledged banking license serving the Mainland China market. Second Line of Defense (‘2LoD’) oversight for Liquidity Risk, Non-Trading Market Risk (Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Book - IRRBB), and Balance Sheet Risks is executed by Finance CRO (FinCRO).
The Treasury Risk Vice President (C13) leads independent 2LoD oversight, risk limit framework design/recalibration, quantitative risk analysis, and credible challenge for Non-Trading Market Risk and Liquidity Risk across CCCL.
The role ensures robust governance across risk appetite, intraday liquidity, internal/regulatory liquidity stress testing, IRRBB supervisory frameworks (including Supervisory Outlier Tests), behavioral modeling assumptions, and regulatory compliance with PBOC/NFRA and Basel standards.
Job Background / Context
CCCL’s Independent Risk Management acts as the second line of defense for the holistic management of risk across all business lines and entities in China. Within Independent Risk Management, the Finance CRO team provides independent oversight, review, and credible challenge to 1LoD functions (Corporate Treasury, Market Treasury, and Global Markets).
The team ensures CCCL maintains an adequate liquidity profile, resilient intraday payment/settlement capacity, and an optimized balance sheet structure that operates strictly within Board-approved Risk Appetite thresholds for Liquidity, IRRBB, Capital Adequacy, and Investments. The VP serves as a senior subject matter expert driving quantitative risk analytics, limit calibrations, and regulatory engagements.
Key Responsibilities
Risk Limit Setting, Calibration & Risk Appetite Framework
Limit Setting & Recalibration: Lead the periodic and ad-hoc review, establishment, and quantitative recalibration of CCCL’s Treasury Risk Limit Framework covering Liquidity, IRRBB, and balance sheet structure.
Risk Appetite & Triggers: Formulate and recalibrate Board-approved Risk Appetite Statements (RAS), Early Warning Indicators (EWIs), and management triggers to reflect balance sheet changes, business strategy, and market dynamics.
Methodology Challenge: Provide formal 2LoD challenge on underlying limit methodologies, allocation waterfalls, buffer sizing, and scenario severity parameters.
Liquidity Risk Management & Intraday Liquidity Oversight
Intraday Liquidity Oversight: Drive 2LoD monitoring and independent oversight of intraday liquidity risk, time-critical payment/clearing obligations (CNAPS/CIPS), and intraday collateral mobilization.
Payment Buffer & Collateral Adequacy: Assess and challenge CCCL’s intraday liquidity buffers, credit lines, central bank pledged collateral, and overdraft facilities under normal and stressed conditions.
Contingency Funding Planning (CFP): Review and challenge the operational feasibility of CCCL’s Contingency Funding Plan, liquidity escalation triggers, and asset monetization capabilities.
Liquidity Stress Testing (LST) & Scenario Modeling
Internal Stress Testing (ILST): Lead 2LoD review and credible challenge of CCCL’s Internal Liquidity Stress Testing frameworks, Resolution Liquidity Adequacy (RLAP/RLEN), and survival horizon metrics.
Scenario Design & Assumptions: Assess the severity and relevance of idiosyncratic, systemic, and combined stress scenarios; review cash flow projections, deposit runoff assumptions, contingent liquidity draws, and wholesale funding rollovers.
HQLA Buffer Sizing: Evaluate the sizing, composition, currency mix, and unencumbered status of CCCL’s High-Quality Liquid Assets buffer.

jobs.descriptionText:
We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Head of Operations to establish and lead the entire operational framework for our new brokerage in China. This is a unique opportunity to build a world-class operations department from scratch. The ideal candidate will be a hands-on leader with deep expertise in China's securities market, regulatory landscape, and operational best practices. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing all operational processes, systems, and teams to ensure efficiency, scalability, and full compliance with Chinese regulations.
Key Responsibilities
Operational Strategy & Setup
Develop and execute the end-to-end operational strategy for the new brokerage.
Lead the setup of all operational infrastructure, including clearing, settlement, custody, and client services.
Select, implement, and integrate key operational systems and technologies (e.g., OMS, PMS, back-office systems, Rootnet)
Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management
Ensure all operations are fully compliant with regulations from the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC), the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), and other relevant authorities.
Establish and maintain robust internal controls, policies, and procedures (e.g., for AML/KYC, trade processing, and data privacy).
Develop and oversee the firm's operational risk management framework to identify, mitigate, and report risks.
Team Leadership & Development
Build, train, and lead a high-performing operations team.
Foster a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Set performance goals and provide ongoing coaching and development for team members.
Core Operations Management
Oversee daily operations including trade capture, confirmation, clearing, and settlement for equities.
Manage cash management, and securities financing operations.
Establish and manage the client onboarding process, ensuring efficient and compliant KYC and account opening procedures.
Stakeholder & Vendor Management
Act as the primary liaison with key external partners, including local exchanges (SSE, SZSE), clearing houses (CSDC, SHCH), custodian banks, and technology vendors.
Collaborate closely with internal departments, including Front Office, Compliance, Finance, and Technology, to ensure seamless business integration.
Financial & Performance Management
Develop and manage the operations department's budget.
Define, monitor, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) to drive efficiency and service quality.
Lead projects aimed at process optimization and automation.
Qualifications
Experience:
Minimum of 15+ years of experience in securities brokerage operations, with at least 7 years in a senior leadership role (e.g., Head/Director of Operations).
Proven track record of setting up and managing operations for a securities firm in mainland China is essential.
Extensive experience in a start-up or new business launch environment is highly desirable.
Knowledge & Skills:
In-depth knowledge of China's A-share market, fixed income market, and related financial products.
Expert understanding of the Chinese regulatory environment, including rules set by CSRC, PBOC, and SAFE.
Strong familiarity with local market infrastructure, including CSDC, CFETS, and major exchanges.
Demonstrated ability in process design, re-engineering, and implementing operational systems.
Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Education & Language:
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. An MBA or other advanced degree is a plus.
Fluency in Mandarin Chinese is mandatory.
Professional proficiency in English is highly preferred.

jobs.title: Corp Client Executive - Treasury and Trade Solutions - VP - SHANGHAI
jobs.descriptionText:
The Global Client Executive is a pivotal, senior-level role responsible for managing and growing our most important top-tier corporate client relationships. You will serve as the primary interface for a dedicated client portfolio, acting as their advocate within Citi and a trusted strategic advisor. Your mission is to drive revenue growth and retention by ensuring an unparalleled client experience, fostering deep partnerships with key decision-makers, and strategically aligning Citi’s products and services with their business objectives.
Detailed Responsibilities
Client Relationship Management:
Cultivate and maintain strong, long-lasting partnerships with key client executives and decision-makers, establishing yourself as a trusted advisor for their treasury and financial needs.
Strategic Revenue Growth:
Take commercial ownership of your client portfolio. Identify and pursue opportunities for strategic growth, including cross-selling and up-selling of Treasury and Trade Solutions, to meet and exceed revenue targets.
Data-Driven Strategic Insight:
Leverage client feedback, performance data, and market trend analysis to provide strategic insights that enhance client satisfaction, inform investment decisions, and foster measurable business growth.
Executive-Level Client Advocacy:
Champion client needs within the organization. Collaborate seamlessly with internal partners across Sales, Product, Operations, and Service to resolve complex issues promptly and ensure superior client outcomes.
Strategic Account Planning:
Lead proactive relationship reviews with key clients to understand their strategic objectives. Develop and execute comprehensive account plans that drive product adoption, ensure revenue realization, and align with the client’s long-term goals.
Proactive Stakeholder Communication:
Ensure internal stakeholders are proactively informed of client needs, product requirements, and strategic priorities to foster alignment and drive execution.
Development Value
This role offers significant strategic development opportunities, including:
In-depth Strategic Understanding:
Cultivate a profound understanding of customer Treasury organizations, specific industries, treasury functions, and the Treasury and Trade Services (TTS) business, its products, risks, and controls, enhancing strategic insight.
Expanded Global Network & Strategic Relationships:
Grow your Citi network across the globe, establishing key strategic relationships that drive business outcomes.
Accelerated Career Advancement:
Expand and strengthen strategic knowledge, paving the way for advanced opportunities within Sales, Product, or Risk leadership
Qualifications
A university degree or Equivalent experience.
5+ years of work experience in a senior client-facing role within corporate banking, relationship management, or sales, with a proven track record of leading high-impact strategic projects.
Strategic Thinking:
Ability to develop forward-looking plans that deliver sustainable growth and a competitive advantage.
Leadership:
Proven experience in motivating and guiding cross-functional teams to achieve ambitious strategic goals.
Business Acumen:
A deep understanding of global business, financial drivers, and the treasury solutions landscape.
Communication & Influence:
Exceptional verbal and written skills with the ability to influence, negotiate, and strategically engage diverse internal and external stakeholders at a senior level.
Problem-Solving:
A strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify complex challenges and design innovative, strategic solutions.
A proven track record of autonomous strategic leadership, ownership, and independent execution of complex tasks.
Diversity & Inclusion
Citi values diversity. We appreciate a diverse workforce and recognize that differences in style and perspective add strategic value to decisions, actions, and organizational success.
Citi is an Equal Opportunities Employer.

Effort: minimal physical effort required.

jobs.descriptionText:
Citi Commercial Bank offers its clients the convenience, a global banking network, thought leadership and global financial capabilities of Citi. We deliver extensive industry knowledge, local expertise and dedicated service support to Mid-Market companies, with an international footprint. We are focused on providing banking and financial solutions to our clients across 5 key growth industries - Business & Professional Services, Industrials, Digital, Technology & Communications, Consumer and Healthcare.
The primary responsibility of the Associate will be, in cooperation with the Senior Relationship Managers, servicing the banking & financing needs of international Mid-Market clients, deepening existing client relationships and acquiring & onboarding new commercial banking clients.
Responsibilities
Build relationships with Citi network and operational teams, becoming one of the key contacts for clients’ requests, internal requests/escalation and resolution.
Support Senior Relationship manager in management of assigned portfolio of clients.
Work closely with Senior Relationship Managers to ensure we provide a 'Client First' approach and help to deliver outstanding day to day banking & operational support to our Mid-Market clients.
In cooperation with Senior Relationship Manager calls on clients and maximise ‘One Citi’ client experience, by proactively leveraging and sharing Citi’s market leading insights, global network and solutions.
Monitor and support products’ implementation processes, clients on-boarding process and manage sales CRM platform.
Liaise with Relationship Associate to ensure adherence to global KYC (Know Your Customer) standards during the onboarding process and, on an ongoing basis, ensuring the appropriate compliance deliverables are met.
Develops and maintains strong ties with Commercial Banking teams across the globe, in particular CCB colleagues working across the same sector vertical, CCB colleagues supporting subsidiary businesses overseas (Commercial Subsidiaries Group). Collaborate and work closely with various product teams (cash sales, trade finance, markets, corporate finance), Underwriting / Risk teams.
Work with Senior Relationship Managers to analyse client relationships, risks & opportunities, assists with credit application write-up, financial spreading, deal structuring, returns calculation, documentation review & preparation. Administrate the credit relationship of clients, ensuring the proper application of policies and institutional processes.
Understand key commercial banking processes & solutions, including Transactional Banking, FX, Trade, Treasury, Working Capital and Lending products.
Support Senior Relationship Managers on solutioning assessment, preparation of pitch books and meeting materials, assists with new clients’ acquisition.
Work collaboratively with key internal stakeholders across CCB, share best practice across teams in order to deliver 'best in class' relationship management to new and existing clients.
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behaviour, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
Qualifications
5-8 years of experience
Previous banking experience
Working within Commercial/Corporate banking is desirable.
Experience in a Client Relationship role or client facing role.
Sales, presentation and communication skills. Focus on first class service quality.
Analytical and credit skills
High level of self-motivation
Knowledge of general banking processes, general understanding of commercial banking solutions
Ability to build & develop strong client relationships.
Effective collaboration skills with Senior Relationship Managers and Commercial Banking partners
Analytical and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft and CRM applications

The overall objective of this role is to utilize research to improve existing products and regularly engage clients to discuss margin effectiveness and optimization.

Aggregate and process large amounts of publicly available data for relevant markets to direct risk management decisions and client solutions
Perform data analyses and research to evaluate performance, determine new strategies and products, and provide product feedback internally
Develop performance evaluation methodologies and attribution models for different execution products
Coordinate with quants, technology, compliance and other partners to drive product development
Engage clients by providing thematic content, market and bespoke analysis, and discuss margin effectiveness and optimization
Define metrics with partners to be distributed to senior management and other stakeholders
Develop the risk and margin methodology and product platform and establish risk framework guidelines
Leading strong governance and controls:
Work in close partnership with control functions such as Legal, Compliance, Market and Credit Risk, Audit, Finance in order to ensure appropriate governance and control infrastructure
Build a culture of responsible finance, good governance and supervision, expense discipline and ethics
Appropriately assess risk/reward of transactions when making business decisions; and ensure that all team members understand the need to do the same, demonstrating proper consideration for the firm’s reputation.

Advance statistics and data analysis background, with modelling capabilities, and spreadsheet oversight greatly preferred
Proven success with a programing background in one or more programming languages, including: Q/KDB, Python, R

jobs.descriptionText:
The Credit Officer 2 is a seasoned professional role. Applies in-depth disciplinary knowledge, contributing to the development of new techniques and the improvement of processes and work-flow for the area or function. Integrates subject matter and industry expertise within a defined area. Requires in-depth understanding of how areas collectively integrate within the sub-function as well as coordinate and contribute to the objectives of the function and overall business. Evaluates moderately complex and variable issues with substantial potential impact, where development of an approach/taking of an action involves weighing various alternatives and balancing potentially conflicting situations using multiple sources of information. Requires good analytical skills in order to filter, prioritize and validate potentially complex and dynamic material from multiple sources. Strong communication and diplomacy skills are required. Regularly assumes informal/formal leadership role within teams. Involved in coaching and training of new recruits Significant impact in terms of project size, geography, etc. by influencing decisions through advice, counsel and/or facilitating services to others in area of specialization. Work and performance of all teams in the area are directly affected by the performance of the individual.
Responsibilities
Develop recommendations to adjust credit policies by analyzing credit and financial performance utilizing statistical scoring, segmentation, regression and simulation techniques
Implement initiatives to ensure consistency and compliance with credit policies
Utilize SAS in a UNIX environment to perform risk, financial and data analysis including profiling, sampling, reconciliation, and quality testing
Prepare risk management presentations for senior management that include analytics on portfolio performance, emerging trends and areas of opportunity
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

5-8 years relevant experience
Degree in Quantitative Fields such as Economics, Engineering, Operations Research, Business Finance, or Mathematics (Master’s degree preferred)

Demonstrated ability to synthesize, prioritize and drive results with a high sense of urgency
Must be highly organized and able to work in a fast paced environment managing multiple projects and possess effective interpersonal, organizational and analytic skills

Demonstrates high level of diligence, motivation and organizational skills.
Focuses on timely and accurate delivery of all account opening functions, as well as delivering superior customer service and resolution of customer issues.

Monitors customer satisfaction and service level and drives process changes. Provides innovative solutions to clients.
Ensures a robust processing environment with effective controls. Establishes risk management practice.
Maintains a culture of risk and controls in the team through various processes and check points. Identifies means to reduce transaction defects (internal and external). Develops performance matrices to track defects, productivity. Ensures clean audit results.
Efficiently and effectively manages new projects and ensures smooth cutover with minimized risks.
Engages in project planning including cost management. Develops training content, training materials, trackers for the migration.
Supports training for new staff. Develops job descriptions for hiring. Manages subordinate supervisors and project staff. Manages occasionally complex and variable issues with significant departmental impact.

Qualifications
6-10 years of experience in documentation review, account maintenance and related cash products.
Bachelor's degree in finance or economy.
Good interpersonal communication skills. Able to communicate with internal and external business partners.
Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication skills.
Demonstrated Project management skill including financial cost management skills.
Advanced execution skills in a prioritization mode. Exposure to Customer Service and handling of system, testing and rollouts.
Ability to achieve business objectives without compromising on controls and risk parameters established. Ability to interact confidently with senior management and / or regulators. Ability to coach and develop people, identifying and retaining talent. Able to partner with businesses and other support functions at senior levels in setting strategy and priorities. Able to strive under pressure and covert opportunity from risk. Should be open to working staggered hour /shift / over weekend and on public holidays. To ensure excellent rapport with internal stakeholders including peers and seniors and duly provide inputs to the team and ensure timely resolution of all issues, wherever there are business risks and the issues need to get addressed such cases should be raised to the senior’s forum for appropriate action and advice.
Proficient knowledge of English (written and spoken).

jobs.descriptionText:
The Trader is a senior level position responsible for overseeing a trading book and managing book risk, in coordination with the Trading team. The overall objective of this role is to ensure book trades deliver on budgeted revenues, and to coordinate with key stakeholders to develop the trading franchise.
Responsibilities
Oversee a trading book and generate revenues and manage risk for the respective business
Coordinate with Sales, Research and other organizations across broader business
Trade a book and deliver on budgeted revenues and manage book risk
Establish and maintain key relationships to deliver trades to the desk
Anticipate client demand in each respective product/market
Coordinate with desk analysts as needed and with sales to develop the franchise
Leading strong governance and controls:
Work in close partnership with control functions such as Legal, Compliance, Market and Credit Risk, Audit, Finance in order to ensure appropriate governance and control infrastructure
Build a culture of responsible finance, good governance and supervision, expense discipline and ethics
Appropriately assess risk/reward of transactions when making business decisions; demonstrating proper consideration for the firm’s reputation.
Be familiar with and adhere to Citi’s Code of Conduct and the Plan of Supervision for Global Markets and Securities Services
Adhere to all policies and procedures as defined by your role which will be communicated to you
Obtain and maintain all registrations/licenses which are required for your role, within the appropriate timeframe
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
Qualifications
6-10 years of experience in a related role
Knowledge of respective products and clients
Required CSRC licensing and registrations as applicable
Advance analytical and numerical competency
Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication
Effective interpersonal skills to develop and maintain relationships with internal and external stakeholders
Ability to analyze and pitch situations and determine suitable counterparties
Knowledge of Bloomberg, booking systems, trading protocol, closing technicalities
Education
Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
Master’s degree preferred

jobs.descriptionText:
The Research Analyst is a seasoned professional role. Applies in-depth disciplinary knowledge, contributing to the development of new techniques and the improvement of processes and work-flow for the area or function. Integrates subject matter and industry expertise within a defined area. Requires in-depth understanding of how areas collectively integrate within the sub-function as well as coordinate and contribute to the objectives of the function and overall business. Evaluates moderately complex and variable issues with substantial potential impact, where development of an approach/taking of an action involves weighing various alternatives and balancing potentially conflicting situations using multiple sources of information. Requires good analytical skills in order to filter, prioritize and validate potentially complex and dynamic material from multiple sources. Strong communication and diplomacy skills are required. Regularly assumes informal/formal leadership role within teams. Involved in coaching and training of new recruits. Significant impact in terms of project size, geography, etc. by influencing decisions through advice, counsel and/or facilitating services to others in area of specialization. Work and performance of all teams in the area are directly affected by the performance of the individual.
Responsibilities
Responsibilities include: building financial models, writing research reports, conducting macroeconomic analysis on the global energy industry, communicating our team's ideas to institutional investors, conducting due diligence and working with Citi's product team to identify trends in the space.
Self-starter; used to working in a team environment and who has the ambition to progress his/her career within equity research
Conduct analysis
Make Investment Recommendations
Interact with Institutional Clients
Arrange company visits and regular management contact for investing clients and due diligence purposes
Attend industry conferences and speak to industry contacts
Track company events and earnings
Develop financial models and valuation techniques
Establish yourself as an expert
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

5-8 years previous experience

jobs.descriptionText:
Description
Citi Research delivers industry-leading investment analysis to Citi’s global institutional investor and wealth management client base. Our team includes some 350 publishing analysts globally, with fundamental coverage of ~3,600 equity securities, as well as areas such as quantitative analysis, economics, fixed-income/rates/credit, FX, commodities, and data analytics. We also deliver access services such as conferences & events, corporate access & visits, and direct insights from market, policy, and industry experts.
Citi Research is seeking a
Supervisory Analyst / Editor / Designated Quality Review Officer (DQRO)
to join our nascent Shanghai-based Research office under Citigroup Securities (China) Co. Ltd. This is a role for a seasoned professional combining responsibilities in editorial, risk management, and operational processes. This role will primarily support and review research product produced by our new Shanghai team, both in English and Chinese. The role may also involve some review of global ex-PRC research product. The role requires strong editorial skills and financial/investment topics comprehension in order to filter, prioritize and validate potentially complex and dynamic material from multiple sources. Strong communication and diplomacy skills are required. Attention to detail is a must!
Key Responsibilities
Review investment research product to ensure compliance with PRC and US FINRA regulations, including reasonable basis and sourcing requirements.
Review investment research product to ensure compliance with Citi’s internal research content guidelines, as detailed in our research guidebooks and policies.
Edit investment research for quality, clarity, commerciality, style, and grammar.
Review both Chinese and English variants, including cross-checking consistency.
Review investment research language/tone and content for franchise risk, with consideration of the firm's reputation and business exposures, and in light of PRC and global political and client sensitivities. Be capable of editing to mitigate such risks (while maintaining our independent views), as well as determining when escalation is appropriate.
Handle the checking of investment research product for 1) issuer mentions for cross-checking against our Watch List; 2) the inclusion of appropriate disclaimers & disclosures; 3) data consistency; and 4) distribution tagging and other product & template elements.
Act as an editorial project manager, providing end-to-end traffic management of work-in-progress, liaising as needed with analyst teams, other Publications staff, product managers, control & compliance teams, data and technical support teams, and other relevant partners, to resolve problems and ensure product ultimately publishes. Additional managerial responsibilities may be assigned, given the need for flexibility in the small startup team.
Broadly as a Citi staffer, assess risk appropriately when business decisions are made, work in compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to policies, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
Qualifications
Have passed the examination uniformly organized by the CSRC for securities business personnel; Securities Association of China (SAC) test.
Holding a FINRA Series-16 license is a major advantage. We may also consider strong candidates without Series-16 and would sponsor them to sit the exam, including providing study materials. Quick study prep time and then successfully passing this challenging exam is a requirement for the role.
Candidate should have at least five years of experience creating, supporting, or editing investment/financial analytic content. Candidate should be a fluent Chinese and English speaker with evidence of editorial and writing capability.
We expect candidates to have strong familiarity with financial markets, financial terminology, and ongoing business news in PRC, Asia, and globally.
Ability to prioritize and to juggle multiple tasks simultaneously amid tight deadlines.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to exercise sound and balanced judgment.
Meticulous and detail oriented. Key aspects of the role involve being able to remember and apply many guidelines and procedures on a consistent and reliable basis.
Team members should have comfort working with sometimes complex publishing software platforms (e.g. Sinitek) and ability to coordinate with partner teams when trouble-shooting technical issues.
Team player with good interpersonal skills, and the patience and diplomacy to work with demanding internal customers and effectively find win-win solutions.

The Client Onboard Analyst 1 is a trainee professional role. Requires a good knowledge of the range of processes, procedures and systems to be used in carrying out assigned tasks and a basic understanding of the underlying concepts and principles upon which the job is based. Good understanding of how the team interacts with others in accomplishing the objectives of the area. Makes evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information. They are expected to resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents. Must be able to exchange information in a concise and logical way as well as be sensitive to audience diversity. Limited but direct impact on the business through the quality of the tasks/services provided. Impact of the job holder is restricted to own job.
Responsibilities
Processes client’s requests related to system set up including signatories’ updates and documentation lodgment.
Co-operates with internal partners to perform systems maintenance based on documentation related to account opening and maintenance processes.
Provides response to client and internal inquiries.
Prepares documentation for archiving .
Applies appropriate bank’s regulations while processing the requests.
Remains up to date with the current procedures, internal rules, external regulations, and follows the changes in the aforementioned documents.
Documents operation procedure updates.
Processes clients’ instructions ensuring the highest accuracy and effectiveness (ensuring deadlines are adhered to).
Verification and authorization of data entered in the systems.
Ensures all queries are dealt with in an efficient and timely manner.
Escalates urgent / risk issues through the appropriate escalation channels.
Co-operates with and supports other teams/employees upon supervisor’s instruction, including possibility of movement to another team and/or process.
Performs other crucial tasks instructed by supervisors, e.g. participation in trainings, projects, conference calls, systems’ testing.
Ensures high levels of client satisfaction through strong product, process and client knowledge. Identifies and suggests process improvements.
Assists in the implementation of validated process improvements.
Understands procedures and controls for operational processes. Supports Manager with quality assurance process. Understands procedures and controls for operational processes. Performs within departmental procedures and compliance standards in order to minimize losses.
Responsible for coordination of projects around internal processes. Participates in user acceptance test of new systems.

Daily deliverable of routine and defined tasks, while developing knowledge of the broader context in which work is being performed.

Qualifications
Previous experience in financial services preferred.
Knowledge of Markets products, KYC as well as opening and maintaining of Markets Trading accounts Customer communication experience (internal/external). Knowledge on the field of finances and banking.
Flexibility, team spirit, loyalty. High attention to detail. Good PC skills (Excel, Word). Fluent in both written and spoken English. Be able to work under pressure and to meet deadlines. Proficient knowledge of English (written and spoken).

Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience

Position Overview
Details of the Division and Team:
The Credit Trader (Fixed Income & Currencies) is responsible for market-making in CNY corporate bonds and managing book risk across a diverse range of products, including rates bonds, interest rate swaps (IRS), and FX.This role drives franchise growth by developing new products, expanding origination and distribution channels in collaboration with Sales, and ensuring rigorous risk management.
What We Will Offer You
A healthy, engaged and well-supported workforce are better equipped to do their best work and, more importantly, enjoy their lives inside and outside the workplace. That’s why we are committed to providing an environment with your development and wellbeing at its centre.
You can expect:
Supplemental Savings Plan on top of mandatory social security
15 days of annual paid leave, plus public holiday & Flexible Working Arrangement
A range of competitive benefits to suit your needs
On-line family doctor consultation for both employee & family members
Employee Assistance Program for both employee & family members
Your key responsibilities:
Fixed Income Trading: Act as the dedicated Fixed Income Trader for DB China flow trading, driving revenue growth while strictly adhering to the established limit framework.
Expand Franchise: Identify and capture new market opportunities to build and scale the bank's franchise alongside internal stakeholders.
Manage Portfolio Risk: Monitor and manage trading book risk dynamically across fixed income, derivatives, and FX products.
Collaborate Across Desks: Partner with Sales and Structuring to enhance product origination and distribution capabilities.
Your skills and experience:
Market Expertise: 2–5 years of trading experience with deep fundamental and technical knowledge of the CNY fixed income market.
Risk Management: Proven understanding of portfolio risk dynamics and the impact of macroeconomic and microeconomic indicators.
Relationship Management: Demonstrated grasp of the sales-trader model, with a track record of building strong internal partnerships and external client relationships.
Core Competencies: Highly motivated, innovative, and detail-oriented, with a strong commitment to operational efficiency.
Communication: Fluent professional English (both written and spoken).
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimize workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs
How We’ll Support You
Flexible working to assist you balance your personal priorities
Coaching and support from experts in your team
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs
Training and development to help you excel in your career
About Us And Our Teams
Deutsche Bank is the leading German bank with strong European roots and a global network. Click here to see what we do.
Deutsche Bank & Diversity
We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.
Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.
We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

Details of the Division and Team:
At the heart of Deutsche Bank's client franchise is the Corporate Bank, a market leader in risk management for Trade Finance, FX and Rates, Cash Management, Lending, Trust and Agency Services as well as Securities Services. Focusing on the treasurers and finance departments of corporate and commercial clients and financial institutions across the globe, our universal expertise and global network allows us to offer truly integrated and effective solutions.
Trade Finance and Lending (TF&L) is hiring to support our Corporate Bank TF&L business in Greater China.
Role Responsibilities
Participate in product planning and execution throughout the product lifecycle for new and existing products
Manage a broad set of activities required to get the product (or set of products) to market and to support it thereafter
Assist in gathering and prioritizing product and customer requirements to define the product vision
Get involved in the validation of all stakeholders on transaction materialization
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure revenue and customer satisfaction goals are made
Provide ongoing analysis of the product in the marketplace, articulates the needs of the market, reports competitor activity and plans development of future releases
Work to ensure the product supports the company’s overall strategy and meets legal and regulatory compliance
Perform other administrative tasks that may be assigned by the team leader.
Your Skills And Experience
Currently in the process of obtaining a bachelor or master degree(or above) in related field, with good financial knowledge
Highly driven individuals that is willing to grind for success
Proficient in English and Chinese
Skilled in Microsoft Office. RPA coding, Alteryx and Pentaho skillsets will be a plus
Can onsite support minimum 4 days a week, six months preferred
We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.
Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.
We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

Key Responsibilities
Do you thrive on intellectual challenges and take pride in building robust, well-designed quantitative solutions? Are you interested in applying advanced quantitative methods to complex financial products for a firm with a truly global footprint? We're looking for an outstanding Quantitative Analyst who can:
Research, develop and enhance the valuation and risk management models and tools supporting Cross Asset Financing businesses, including Structured Financing and Fund Financing.
Apply quantitative techniques to model complex fund structures in bespoke Fund Financing facilities.
Apply advanced statistical techniques to develop prepayment and default models for securitized products.
Partner with other Quantitative Analytics (QA) teams to develop automated and scalable cross-asset solutions used by Trading, Structuring, and Sales.
Collaborate closely with Trading, Structuring, Risk, and Control functions to perform statistical analysis, develop valuation and risk methodologies, and support business decision-making.
The team
The Credit Quantitative Analytics (QA) team is the Front Office group responsible for developing quantitative models, methodologies, and technology that support pricing and risk management for Credit businesses across the firm, including Credit Solutions, Flow Credit, Cross Asset Financing, Global Banking. The team’s models and infrastructure are used for quoting clients, risk managing trading positions, marking the firm’s books and records. The team works closely with Trading, Structuring, IT and control functions, as well as other QA teams such as Equities, FX, Rates and the central infrastructure team.
Your Skills And Experience
Strong academic background, preferably at the Master’s or PhD level, in a quantitative discipline such as Mathematics, Physics, Computational Finance, Engineering, or a related field.
Proficiency in one of the object-oriented programming languages such as C , C#, Java or Python, with the ability to develop robust and scalable quantitative solutions.
A solid foundation in quantitative finance and derivatives pricing, with knowledge of modern numerical and/or machine learning techniques.
Knowledge of securitized products, fixed income analytics, and complex fund structures is a plus.
Ability to apply AI and emerging technologies responsibly to improve business outcomes and operational efficiency.
Ability to communicate complex ideas in a fluent and articulate manner.
About Us
UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.
We know that great work is never done alone. That’s why we place collaboration at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves. Want to find out more? Visit ubs.com/careers.
Join us
At UBS, we know that it's our people, with their diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds, who drive our ongoing success. We’re dedicated to our craft and passionate about putting our people first, with new challenges, a supportive team, opportunities to grow and flexible working options when possible. Our inclusive culture brings out the best in our employees, wherever they are on their career journey. And we use artificial intelligence (AI) to work smarter and more efficiently. We also recognize that great work is never done alone. That’s why collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves.
We’re committed to disability inclusion and if you need reasonable accommodation/adjustments throughout our recruitment process, you can always contact us.

UBS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We respect and seek to empower each individual and support the diverse cultures, perspectives, skills and experiences within our workforce.
